Note: A formal letter usually has 6 parts:
1. Writer's address and date on the top right corner 2. Recipient's designation and official address on the left side but two paces below the date in number 1.
3. The salutation Or (addressing) 4 The body 5. The subscription Yours truly) 6. The signature or name on the bottom right corner However it can be given on the bottom left corner too.
This format is called a semi-block style The letters above are examples of semi-block style
